Subject: Stakeholder mapping + next steps (Spruce Technologies)

Hi Amit / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and excited about where Redwood could help Spruce on conversational search and customer support automation. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Demo summary: low-latency multi-tenant inference, on-prem options for PII redaction, and the Optimize recommendations for cost per 1M tokens.
- Key concerns you raised: SOC 2 scope, data residency, procurement timeline, and the economic buyer confirmation.
- As discussed, the immediate asks we need to unblock procurement:
  1) Stakeholder map / org chart showing decision makers (economic buyer, security, legal, procurement).
  2) Any decision criteria (e.g., latency < 200ms p95, on-prem requirement, required certifications).
  3) Procurement contact and expected PO timeline.

Attached: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (two-page follow-up deck & pricing ranges).

Would you be able to send over an org chart or short intro chains to the relevant folks? If easier, I can draft a short email you can forward to loop in procurement and security.

Proposed next step: 30-minute alignment with your procurement + security + the economic buyer next week. I can work around Marcus's calendar once you confirm.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | m: (415) 555-0123

Thanks for the clear recap. Attached is our current org chart (sprucetech_org_chart_v2.pdf). High level: Marcus Lin (SVP Finance) is the economic buyer for platform purchases. Notes on timeline: We have a budget window closing end of Q1 2027; procurement will likely request a vendor security questionnaire and a draft SOW + pricing to attach to the PO.

I'll loop in Marcus and our security lead next if that's helpful.

I attached a stakeholder_mapping_template.xlsx — feel free to drop names/roles and I can convert it into an internal action plan and can also draft the email you can forward to loop folks in.
